name: self assisted inverse leg curl
description: Kneeling with your ankles locked under rollers, you lower your torso forward and use your hands to help you back up. A body weight move for the hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel on the pad with your ankles locked under the rollers.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, arms crossed or ready in front.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands on the floor at the bottom.
Push off lightly and pull yourself back up to kneeling with your hamstrings.
